messages:
Anya (CS): heads up — NovusHealth (enterprise PO #PO-9927) says the contract promo credits aren't showing on their account after we attached the PO note. customer reports 401s when calling the API since yesterday. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/CS-4832
Kyle (Sales): saw the PO note on the contract: 
```
PO: PO-9927
Notes: APPLY CONTRACT_PROMO_2025 50k CREDITS
Account: novus@novushealth.com
```
They claim credits were promised in renewal. Did finance already apply?
Anya (CS): they were expecting the manual grant during onboarding. I tried to reproduce and got the same 401 on a couple requests. Error body includes "account_billing_suspended" and billing portal shows 0 credits.
Sam (Finance): looking. I don't see a ledger entry for CONTRACT_PROMO_2025 for NovusHealth. Could be a failed job or missing PO mapping. I can do a manual credit but need the accounting code and approval trace. Kyle — can you confirm sales approval (email/PO line) so I can attach as justification?
Kyle (Sales): confirmed —email thread with CFO attached in the CRM (crm://orgs/novushealth/notes/478). PO line has amount and SKU. Approve to apply 50,000 token credits as one-time promo.
Sam (Finance): thanks. I'll queue manual adjustment and timestamp reference in ledger. tagging Billing Bot to create the entry and to ensure no auto-suspend flags remain.
Billing Bot: auto-ledger: received adjustment request for account novus@novushealth.com. Pending manual grant id=MG-2025-179. Will post ledger entry after finance sign-off.
Lisa (Eng): quick note on the 401 — our auth layer blocks requests when billing status = SUSPENDED. If credits are missing the account goes into suspend path. Once Sam confirms manual grant and ledger entry is live, the flag should clear within ~30s. If not, I can kick a cache invalidate on auth-cache for that org.
Sam (Finance): manual credit applied: MG-2025-179 done. Ledger entry id L-888271. Attached reference PO-9927. Posted justification: "Enterprise contract promo per PO-9927 — 50k tokens".
Billing Bot: ledger: entry L-888271 posted. account status updated to ACTIVE.
Anya (CS): relayed to customer — please retry your API calls in ~1m and report back.
NovusHealth (via customer email, posted by Anya): retried and now calls succeed, no 401s. Credits show in billing portal as 50,000. Thank you. :tada:
Kyle (Sales): leaving note in the contract that we applied manual credit and attached ledger id L-888271 and MG-2025-179. I'll follow up with FS to prevent PO mapping gaps.
Anya (CS): closing the loop here. Action items: (1) Sam to add PO mapping checklist for manual grants, (2) Lisa to add small monitor to detect accounts with PO notes but no corresponding ledger entries. Sam, Lisa — can you add to your backlogs?
Sam (Finance): noted, will create ticket FIN-2214 for PO mapping checklist.
Lisa (Eng): adding ENG-789 to track monitor + auth cache fix.
Anya (CS): great — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
